text:
maria: quick follow-up from the quant-profile RFC — we need a clear versioning strategy and override semantics for per-customer profiles. proposing schema + rollout plan. TL;DR: immutable profile versions, thin allowed overrides, canary gating.

devin: +1. key q: how much can overrides affect quality? e.g., forcing int4 for a tenant could be catastrophic. we should only allow runtime-friendly knobs by default.

omkar: runtime note — we rely on a profile_id to key compiled kernels and caches. profile changes must bump profile_id/checksum so caches invalidate deterministically.

jason: ops: proposing canary progression 0.5% -> 5% -> 25% with auto-revert if delta on chosen metric > 1.0% abs. need to agree metric set (f1/accuracy/perplexity by endpoint).

carly: product POV: customers want per-tenant overrides. recommend two modes: managed (Redwood validates + deploys) vs self-serve (customer accepts risk, we expose fewer fields).

maria: rough schema idea (inline example):
```json
{"name":"fp8-ops-2026","version":"v1","profile_id":"sha256:abcd1234...","base_profile_ref":"fp8-default-v2","allowed_overrides":["max_batch","degradation_budget_pct","canary_fraction","max_latency_ms"],"quality_gate":{"metric":"f1_delta_pct","threshold":"1.0"},"canary_defaults":{"fraction":"0.005","duration_min":"60"}}
```

omkar: runtime constraint — if an override touches per-layer quant params or scale factors we must recompile kernels; those should be blocked in self-serve and gated in managed mode.

maria: QA question: we need regression harnesses per-endpoint and domain prompt sets. @carly can we reuse eval infra and attach `canary_probe_prompts` to a profile?

carly: yes. include `canary_probe_prompts` + optional customer probe set for managed mode. product will provide guidance for representative probes.

devin: fallback plan: if canary fails, immediate routing to safer profile (e.g., int8 fallback) with circuit-breaker telemetry. send signal: profile_id + override_source + canary_error_code.

maria: action items: 1) open profile-schema PR with explicit `allowed_overrides` whitelist and immutability rules, 2) runtime: implement profile_id + checksum invalidation, 3) ops: canary runbook + metric list, 4) telemetry: add profile_id and override_source tags. i'll take 1 & 4.

jason: i'll draft the canary thresholds and alert playbook. i'll also add automation for auto-revert at the 5% step if triggered. +1 to immutable versions.

maria: :thumbsup: will write a short RFC follow-up and checklist.

canary-bot: Pipeline queued: profile-canary/fp8-ops-2026:v1 — will run once schema PR merges and CI passes.
